evidence_quotes: move them from a high-risk area (stream bank)
obras para contenção das terras, impermeabilização do solo e canalização de esgoto
rationale: The dispute concerns municipal risk-management and residential removal on a high-risk stream bank due to landslide risk (risco de desmoronamento), in which the court reversed the relocation order and ordered the municipality to urgently construct slope containment, soil waterproofing, and sewage channeling infrastructure (canalização de esgoto). Because the adjudication directly mandates municipal wastewater/sewage channeling infrastructure and regulates residential occupation along a stream bank, it is substantively WATER under both the mananciais-calibrated and strict labels, best categorized as spatial_planning_water.
